answer:
That's stressful, but one bad grade doesn't decide everything. Talking with your professor and an advisor soon can really help.

Grade appeals are considered only when you can provide supporting documentation. Possible grounds include a computational error, factual information not considered when the grade was posted, or an alleged College Policy violation. A degree-conferred record is closed and cannot be adjusted. [2]

Start by contacting the course instructor (undergraduate) or faculty member (graduate) in writing by email or certified letter no later than 20 calendar days after grades are posted. Provide supporting documentation. You and the instructor/faculty member should make good-faith efforts to discuss the issue and have up to 15 calendar days to reach a determination. If you agree an adjustment is warranted, the instructor/faculty member sends an Instructor Grade Adjustment Request and documentation to the sponsoring academic unit’s Dean for approval, then to the Registrar. [3][4]

If you cannot agree, undergraduates may submit a written appeal, by email or certified letter, with pertinent course materials or coursework to the sponsoring academic unit’s Dean within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. The Dean has 15 calendar days to decide. If the Dean does not support the appeal, you may petition the Office of the Provost in writing by email or certified letter within 20 calendar days of the Dean’s final written determination, explaining your position and including evidence contradicting the decision or previously unavailable information. The Provost may reject it unless it clearly shows factual mistake, policy violation, or action outside the Dean’s purview. [3]

Graduate students who cannot agree may submit a written appeal, by email or certified letter, with pertinent course materials or coursework to the graduate program Director within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. The Director recommends a decision to the Dean for final approval. If the Director does not support the appeal, you may petition the supervising Dean with a written statement and evidence; the provided procedure does not state a deadline for that petition. [4]

See the [grade appeal procedure](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#student-appeals-of-an-academic-nature). [2]

After the 100% or 50% refund period, federal aid should not be affected if you remain enrolled in 6 or more credits. NJ State aid requires full-time enrollment when the aid is fully disbursed. [2]

The exact effect on your aid depends on your circumstances; contact the Office of Financial Aid before changing your enrollment. Yes. OSS supports students with temporary disabilities. For exams, extended testing time or alternative testing arrangements are potential accommodations. Log into OSSOnline to review your courses and select accommodations for the semester; your Counselor reviews and approves them. The Public Policy MPP is the Master of Public Policy in the School of Social Sciences and Social Work. It focuses on how government laws and policies shape lives, and prepares students in research methods and skills for work with or for public institutions. Public Policy 4+1 and Public Policy Minor are also published [1].

Requirements [1]: Required courses—all: PUBL 600 THE POLITICS OF POLICYMAKING; PUBL 601 FEDERAL PUBLIC POLICY & GOVERNANCE; PUBL 602 STATE & LOCAL PUBLIC POLICY; PUBL 616 ECONOMETRICS AND ANALYSIS; PUBL 618 PUBLIC MANAGEMENT; PUBL 621 POLITICAL ECONOMY; PUBL 705 PUBLIC POLICY INTERNSHIP. Electives—select 3, at least 3 of: ACCT 502 GOVERNMENT AND NOT-FOR-PROFIT ACCOUNTING; ACCT 625 INTERNATIONAL ACCOUNTING; BADM 501 DATA ANALYTICS; BADM 503 BUSINESS LAW, ETHICS & REGULATORY PRONOUNCEMENTS; DATA 601 INTRODUCTION TO DATA SCIENCE; DATA 670 DATA VISUALIZATION; MATH 570 APPLIED STATISTICS; MATH 685 INTRODUCTION TO EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN; MBAD 610 BECOMING A 21ST CENTURY LEADER; MBAD 625 CRISIS & CHANGE MANAGEMENT; NURS 660 LEADERSHIP AND INNOVATION IN HEALTHCARE; NURS 670 HEALTHCARE ECONOMICS AND FINANCE; NURS 808 HEALTH POLICY LEADERSHIP; MSWK 505 SOCIAL WELFARE PROGRAMS AND POLICIES I; MSWK 507 CULTURAL DIVERSITY, RACISM, OPPRESSION AND PRIVILEGE; MSWK 604 ADVANCED SOCIAL POLICY; MSWK 610 PUBLIC HEALTH IN WEST AFRICA; MSWK 670 SOCIAL WELFARE POLICIES IN HEALTH AND MENTAL HEALTH.

Graduate Admissions lists one professional or academic letter of recommendation; applicants enter references’ names and contact information in the online application, and Ramapo sends an automated request for references to upload their recommendations to the portal. The letter is waived for current Ramapo students graduating in 2027 and recent Ramapo graduates from 2025 and 2026. Also required: a 400-word personal statement describing interest, fit with personal intellectual development, and expected accomplishments, and a resume [6].

**Graduate Admissions**: Phone: (201) 684-7270. Email: graduate@ramapo.edu. Location: McBride House. [15]

Office of the Provost — grade appeals are considered only in limited circumstances and require supporting documentation. Examples include a computational error, factual information not considered when the grade was posted, or an alleged College Policy violation. A need for a higher grade or an academic-integrity penalty are not grounds; after a degree is conferred, its academic record cannot be adjusted. [2]

For an undergraduate course: Within 20 calendar days after grades are posted, email or send a certified letter to your instructor with your appeal and supporting documentation. You and the instructor have up to 15 calendar days to reach a determination. If you agree on an adjustment, the instructor sends an Instructor Grade Adjustment Request and supporting documents to the sponsoring unit’s Dean for approval, then to the Registrar. If you cannot agree, send a written appeal, by email or certified letter, with relevant course materials or coursework to that Dean within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. The Dean has 15 calendar days to decide. If the Dean denies your appeal, you may petition the Office of the Provost in writing, by email or certified letter, within 20 calendar days of the Dean’s final written determination; include your position and evidence of a factual mistake, policy violation, action outside the Dean’s purview, or previously unavailable information. [3]

For a graduate course: The first deadline is also 20 calendar days after grades are posted; write to the faculty member by email or certified letter and provide supporting documentation. You and the faculty member have up to 15 calendar days to reach a determination. If you cannot agree, appeal in writing, with relevant course materials or coursework, to the sponsoring graduate program’s Director within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. The Director recommends a decision to the Dean for final approval. If the Director’s opinion is against your appeal, you may petition the program-supervising Dean in writing, explaining your position and including contradictory or previously unavailable evidence; this section gives no deadline for that petition. [4]

The policy and procedures are here: [https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#student-appeals-of-an-academic-nature](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#student-appeals-of-an-academic-nature) [2][3][4]

Requirements: take all of PUBL 600 THE POLITICS OF POLICYMAKING; PUBL 601 FEDERAL PUBLIC POLICY & GOVERNANCE; PUBL 602 STATE & LOCAL PUBLIC POLICY; PUBL 616 ECONOMETRICS AND ANALYSIS; PUBL 618 PUBLIC MANAGEMENT; PUBL 621 POLITICAL ECONOMY; and PUBL 705 PUBLIC POLICY INTERNSHIP. Select 3 at least 3 of: ACCT 502 GOVERNMENT AND NOT-FOR-PROFIT ACCOUNTING; ACCT 625 INTERNATIONAL ACCOUNTING; BADM 501 DATA ANALYTICS; BADM 503 BUSINESS LAW, ETHICS & REGULATORY PRONOUNCEMENTS; DATA 601 INTRODUCTION TO DATA SCIENCE; DATA 670 DATA VISUALIZATION; MATH 570 APPLIED STATISTICS; MATH 685 INTRODUCTION TO EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN; MBAD 610 BECOMING A 21ST CENTURY LEADER; MBAD 625 CRISIS & CHANGE MANAGEMENT; NURS 660 LEADERSHIP AND INNOVATION IN HEALTHCARE; NURS 670 HEALTHCARE ECONOMICS AND FINANCE; NURS 808 HEALTH POLICY LEADERSHIP; MSWK 505 SOCIAL WELFARE PROGRAMS AND POLICIES I; MSWK 507 CULTURAL DIVERSITY, RACISM, OPPRESSION AND PRIVILEGE; MSWK 604 ADVANCED SOCIAL POLICY; MSWK 610 PUBLIC HEALTH IN WEST AFRICA; MSWK 670 SOCIAL WELFARE POLICIES IN HEALTH AND MENTAL HEALTH. That's stressful, but one bad grade doesn't decide everything. Talking with your professor and an advisor soon can really help.

The Office of the Provost’s catalog page says a grade appeal requires supporting documentation. Possible grounds include a computational error, factual information not considered when the grade was posted, or an alleged College Policy violation. Appeals based only on wanting a higher grade, or on a grade penalty for an Academic Integrity violation, will not be considered. After a degree is conferred, its academic record cannot be adjusted. [2]

Deadline to start: no later than 20 calendar days after grades are posted, email or send a certified letter to your course instructor (undergraduate) or faculty member (graduate), with supporting documentation. You and the instructor/faculty member have up to 15 calendar days to reach a determination. [3][4]

If you’re an undergraduate and cannot agree, send a written appeal by email or certified letter, with pertinent course materials or coursework, to the Dean of the academic unit that sponsored the course within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. The Dean has 15 calendar days to decide. If the Dean does not support your appeal, you may petition the Office of the Provost within 20 calendar days of the Dean’s final written determination. Submit a written statement by email or certified letter with evidence contradicting the Dean’s decision or information previously unavailable. [3]

If you’re a graduate student and cannot agree, submit a written appeal by email or certified letter, with pertinent course materials or coursework, to the Director of the graduate program that sponsored the course within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. The Director’s decision is a recommendation to the Dean for final approval. If the Director does not support your appeal, you may petition the Dean who supervises the program; the provided procedure does not state a deadline for that petition. [4]

Start by affiliating with the Office of Specialized Services (OSS). Check “How To Request OSS Services” ([https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/how-to-request-oss-services/](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/how-to-request-oss-services/)). You must initiate contact with OSS and provide comprehensive disability documentation from a licensed physician, psychiatrist, psychologist, social worker, or certified learning disabilities specialist. [3]

All students must complete an Affiliation Packet. Request it through the OSS Quick Response Form ([https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/oss-quick-response-form/](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/oss-quick-response-form/)) or by emailing oss@ramapo.edu. Send the completed packet and supporting documentation electronically to oss@ramapo.edu. [9]

For housing requests, OSS says to submit a Housing Accommodation Student or Provider Request Form; if you are requesting only a strobe alarm, roll-in shower, wheelchair/mobility accessible residence hall, or 1st floor, you do not need those forms and only need to complete a request for disability support form. See the OSS Housing Accommodations page for the forms and policy: [https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/housing-accommodations/](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/housing-accommodations/) [3][5]

Requests are typically reviewed by a committee. You can expect a decision within twenty one (21) business days after OSS receives all requested documentation. If more information is needed, OSS will tell you in writing and may ask to speak with the professional who supplied it. [4] Once approved, OSS works with Residence Life on placement. Housing depends on availability; special accommodations are first-come-first-served and are not guaranteed. Submit by Residence Life’s published deadlines; a late request may mean Residence Life cannot meet an approved accommodation for that semester. [1][2][6][7]

OSS and/or the Housing Accommodation Request Committee determine whether the request is reasonable. The College may inquire about the animal’s age, size/breed. [4]

Admissions requirements listed: one professional or academic recommendation (enter references’ names and contact information in the online application’s “Recommendations” section; Ramapo sends an automated request and references upload directly to the portal). The Nursing RN to BSN is a Bachelor of Science in Nursing program for registered nurses with an Associate’s degree or nursing Diploma. Students transfer credits from their initial nursing program and complete Ramapo’s general education and nursing requirements. Diploma-program graduates receive 30 credits for their diploma nursing courses after satisfactorily completing their first two BSN nursing courses. [1]

Requirements: Choose one math course: MATH 108 Elementary Probability and Statistics, PSYC 242 Statistics, or SOCI 308 Data Analysis in Sociology. Complete all seven RN to BSN Professional Core courses: NURS 312 Nursing Informatics; NURS 316 Pathophysiology; NURS 325 Nursing Research and Evidence Based Practice; NURS 330 Health Assessment Across the Lifespan; NURS 425 Community Centered Nursing; NURS 445 Leadership in a Global World; and NURS 460 Clinical Management. That's stressful, but one bad grade doesn't decide everything. Talking with your professor and an advisor soon can really help.

A grade appeal requires supporting documentation. Possible grounds include a computational error, factual information not available when the grade was posted (such as submitted work not graded), or an alleged College Policy violation. Appeals based only on wanting a higher grade, or a grade penalty for an Academic Integrity violation, are not considered. A degree’s record cannot be adjusted after the degree is conferred. [2]

Undergraduate: Email or send a certified letter to the course instructor within 20 calendar days after grades are posted, with supporting documentation. Both sides should try in good faith to resolve the difference; you have up to 15 calendar days to reach a determination. If you agree on an adjustment, the instructor sends the request and documentation to the course Dean for approval, then to the Registrar. If you cannot agree, send a written appeal with relevant course materials or work to the Dean within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. The Dean has 15 calendar days to decide. If the Dean rejects the appeal, you may petition the Office of the Provost in writing, by email or certified letter, within 20 calendar days of the Dean’s final written decision. Include your position and evidence contradicting the decision or previously unavailable information. [3]

Graduate: Write to the faculty member by email or certified letter within 20 calendar days after grades are posted, with supporting documentation. If unresolved, submit a written appeal with relevant course materials or work to the program Director within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. If the Director does not support the appeal, you may petition the program-supervising Dean in writing, explaining your position and including contradictory or previously unavailable evidence. [4]

The procedure is here: [grade appeal policy](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#student-appeals-of-an-academic-nature). [2][3][4]

Federal aid requires at least 6 credits: going from 12 to 6 credits reduces your federal Pell Grant, but you can keep federal loans. After the 100% or 50% refund period, federal aid should not be affected if you remain enrolled in 6 or more credits. NJ State aid (e.g., TAG, EOF) requires full-time enrollment when the aid is fully disbursed. [2]

If you have an Academic Scholarship or Ramapo grant, dropping below 12 credits may reduce or cancel it for the semester. Contact the Office of Financial Aid to discuss your situation before dropping below full-time; it also recommends discussing a withdrawal with them to learn how it may affect your aid package. The Office of Specialized Services (OSS) handles the disability affiliation and accommodation request. First, initiate contact with OSS and register for affiliation. Submit comprehensive documentation from a licensed physician, psychiatrist, psychologist, social worker, or certified learning disabilities specialist; it must establish eligibility and help determine appropriate accommodations. [3]

Request an Affiliation Packet through the OSS Quick Response Form ([https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/oss-quick-response-form/](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/oss-quick-response-form/)) or email oss@ramapo.edu. Send the completed packet and supporting documentation electronically to oss@ramapo.edu. [9] For medical-impairment documentation, OSS lists a guideline (PDF: [https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/wp-content/uploads/sites/137/2013/06/Medical_Documentation_Guidelines.pdf](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/wp-content/uploads/sites/137/2013/06/Medical_Documentation_Guidelines.pdf); DOC: [https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/wp-content/uploads/sites/137/2013/06/Medical-Impairment-Documentation-Guidelines.doc](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/wp-content/uploads/sites/137/2013/06/Medical-Impairment-Documentation-Guidelines.doc)) and a writable form ([https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/wp-content/uploads/sites/137/2020/06/Medical-Impairments-Documentation-Form-fillable-2-6-2020.pdf](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/wp-content/uploads/sites/137/2020/06/Medical-Impairments-Documentation-Form-fillable-2-6-2020.pdf)). [8]

See OSS’s housing accommodation page and request policy: [https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/housing-accommodations/](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/housing-accommodations/) and [https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/wp-content/uploads/sites/137/2024/03/1-Housing-Accommodation-Request-Policy-updated-3-7-24.pdf](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/wp-content/uploads/sites/137/2024/03/1-Housing-Accommodation-Request-Policy-updated-3-7-24.pdf). [5] Requests are typically reviewed by a committee; expect a decision within twenty one (21) business days after OSS receives all requested documentation. If more information is needed, OSS will notify you in writing and may contact the professional who supplied it. [4] Once affiliated, OSS informs Residence Life of approved accommodations based on the medical documentation. [1]

Housing accommodations depend on availability; accessible housing is limited, requests are not guaranteed, and are provided first-come-first-served. Submit by Residence Life’s published deadlines; a late request may prevent Residence Life from meeting an approved accommodation for the semester requested. [1][2][7] Students requesting only a strobe alarm, roll-in shower, wheelchair/mobility accessible residence hall, or 1st floor do not need the Housing Accommodation Student or Provider Request Forms; they need only a request for disability support form. [3]

The Public Policy MPP is a Master of Public Policy in the School of Social Sciences and Social Work. It studies how governmental laws and policies shape lives and develops research, quantitative and qualitative methods, and skills for work with or for public institutions. [1] Catalog: [https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SO-MPP-PBPL](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SO-MPP-PBPL). Also published: Public Policy 4+1 and Public Policy Minor. [1]

Requirements: take all of PUBL 600 THE POLITICS OF POLICYMAKING; PUBL 601 FEDERAL PUBLIC POLICY & GOVERNANCE; PUBL 602 STATE & LOCAL PUBLIC POLICY; PUBL 616 ECONOMETRICS AND ANALYSIS; PUBL 618 PUBLIC MANAGEMENT; PUBL 621 POLITICAL ECONOMY; PUBL 705 PUBLIC POLICY INTERNSHIP. Select at least 3 electives: ACCT 502 GOVERNMENT AND NOT-FOR-PROFIT ACCOUNTING; ACCT 625 INTERNATIONAL ACCOUNTING; BADM 501 DATA ANALYTICS; BADM 503 BUSINESS LAW, ETHICS & REGULATORY PRONOUNCEMENTS; DATA 601 INTRODUCTION TO DATA SCIENCE; DATA 670 DATA VISUALIZATION; MATH 570 APPLIED STATISTICS; MATH 685 INTRODUCTION TO EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN; MBAD 610 BECOMING A 21ST CENTURY LEADER; MBAD 625 CRISIS & CHANGE MANAGEMENT; NURS 660 LEADERSHIP AND INNOVATION IN HEALTHCARE; NURS 670 HEALTHCARE ECONOMICS AND FINANCE; NURS 808 HEALTH POLICY LEADERSHIP; MSWK 505 SOCIAL WELFARE PROGRAMS AND POLICIES I; MSWK 507 CULTURAL DIVERSITY, RACISM, OPPRESSION AND PRIVILEGE; MSWK 604 ADVANCED SOCIAL POLICY; MSWK 610 PUBLIC HEALTH IN WEST AFRICA; MSWK 670 SOCIAL WELFARE POLICIES IN HEALTH AND MENTAL HEALTH. [1]

Admissions page: [https://www.ramapo.edu/graduate/requirements/](https://www.ramapo.edu/graduate/requirements/). It lists one professional or academic recommendation; enter references’ names and contact information in the online application’s ‘Recommendations’ section, and Ramapo sends an automated request for them to upload directly to the application portal. The recommendation is waived for current Ramapo students graduating in 2027 and recent Ramapo graduates from 2025 and 2026. It also lists a 400-word personal statement describing your interest, fit with personal intellectual development, and what you expect to accomplish, and a resume. [6]

A grade appeal is considered only in limited circumstances and requires supporting documentation. Possible grounds include a computational error, factual information not considered when the grade was posted, or an alleged College Policy violation. [2]

Undergraduate: Within 20 calendar days after grades are posted, email or send a certified letter to the course instructor with supporting documentation. You and the instructor have up to 15 calendar days to reach a determination. If you agree on a warranted adjustment, the instructor sends an Instructor Grade Adjustment Request and documentation to the sponsoring academic unit’s Dean for approval, then to the Registrar. If you cannot agree, send a written appeal by email or certified letter, with pertinent course materials or coursework, to that Dean within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. If the Dean denies it, you may petition the Office of the Provost in writing by email or certified letter within 20 calendar days of the Dean’s final written determination. The petition must explain your position and include evidence contradicting the Dean or previously unavailable. [3]

Graduate: Within 20 calendar days after grades are posted, email or send a certified letter to the faculty member with supporting documentation. You have up to 15 calendar days to reach a determination. If you cannot agree, submit a written appeal by email or certified letter, with pertinent course materials or coursework, to the graduate program’s Director within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. The Director’s decision is a recommendation to the Dean for final approval. If the Director does not support your appeal, you may petition the supervising Dean in writing, explaining your position and including evidence contradicting the Director or previously unavailable. [4]

The policy is in the [Student Appeals of an Academic Nature catalog page](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#student-appeals-of-an-academic-nature). [2][3][4]

The Office of Specialized Services (OSS) handles the affiliation and disability documentation process. First, register for affiliation with OSS and initiate contact; see “How To Request OSS Services” for information. Submit comprehensive documentation of your disability from a licensed physician, psychiatrist, psychologist, social worker, or certified learning disabilities specialist. You must also complete an Affiliation Packet, available through the OSS Quick Response Form; send the completed packet and supporting documentation electronically as directed on the documentation page. [3][9]

Then request housing accommodation through OSS. Its Housing Accommodations page links the Housing Accommodation Request Policy and necessary forms. Requests should be submitted by Residence Life’s published deadlines; this information gives no specific deadline. [1][5][7] Requests are reviewed, typically by a committee, and a decision is expected within twenty one (21) business days after OSS receives all requested documentation. Housing is subject to availability, and late requests may not be accommodated for the requested semester. [2][4]

If you request only a strobe alarm, roll-in shower, wheelchair/mobility accessible residence hall, or 1st floor, you do not need the Housing Accommodation Student or Provider Request Forms; complete only a request for disability support form. [3]

Yes, an emotional support animal may be allowed as a disability accommodation, but you must be approved. Its presence may be limited to defined campus areas and generally is not permitted in academic or recreational facilities. [2][3]

The Office of Specialized Services (OSS) handles the process:
1. Call 201-684-7514 to discuss your interest; OSS will schedule a meeting with its Director. [1]
2. Register with OSS first. Initiate contact and submit comprehensive disability documentation from a licensed physician, psychiatrist, psychologist, social worker, or certified learning disabilities specialist. See “How To Request OSS Services”: [https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/how-to-request-oss-services/](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/how-to-request-oss-services/) [5]
3. Submit the Animal Documentation Form 2022: [https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/wp-content/uploads/sites/137/2022/07/Animal-Documentation-Form-fillable-updated-7-5-22.pdf](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/wp-content/uploads/sites/137/2022/07/Animal-Documentation-Form-fillable-updated-7-5-22.pdf) [6]
4. OSS and/or the Housing Accommodation Request Committee decide whether the request is reasonable and sufficiently documented. It may be denied for inadequate documentation, an undue burden, a fundamental change to housing policy, or a direct threat or substantial property damage; the College may also ask about the animal’s age, size/breed. [4]

For housing accommodations, submit the appropriate forms by Residence Life’s published deadlines. OSS informs Residence Life of approved housing needs after you affiliate; accommodations are first-come, are not guaranteed, and may depend on availability. A late request may prevent Residence Life from meeting an approved accommodation for the requested semester. [7][14][15]
